description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the VacancyAPI in the Recruitment API module of the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations like create, update, delete, and retrieval (get all, get one) of vacancy data, using mock services and fixture data.

classes.name: VacancyAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the VacancyAPI endpoints related to recruitment vacancies in OrangeHRM. It includes methods for testing create, update, delete, get all, and get one vacancy operations using mock services and fixture data.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a vacancy via the VacancyAPI using a data provider.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing vacancy via the VacancyAPI using a data provider.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a vacancy via the VacancyAPI using a data provider.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all vacancies via the VacancyAPI using a data provider.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single vacancy via the VacancyAPI using a data provider.
